# std.map

Ordered maps and sets, as ordinary CP: `Map` and `Set` keep their keys in `<` order in an AVL tree, \(O(\log n)\) a step. Core re-exports both, so no module imports them.

Import: `use std.map.{...}`.

## `struct Set<T>`

An ordered set: its elements in `<` order, each once; `O(log n)` to add, remove and find one (R07.2.4).

## `struct Map<K, V>`

An ordered map: each key once, in `<` order, with its value; \(O(\log n)\) to read, write and remove one.
